metadata.title: Alexandrov Regions
metadata.abstract: We introduce the notion of Alexandrov region. In contrast to Alexandrov spaces these are intrinsic metric spaces, which satisfy a lower curvature bound and have finite Hausdorff dimension, might however, be non-complete. We show a quantitative version of the statement that such regions are locally isometric to an Alexandrov space.
